name: Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology PhD
summary: Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology PhD with an individually tailored research program and faculty mentor commitment required from the start.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Complete fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated recurring deadline. Later consideration only if a matched mentor requests an exception.

timeline.decisions: For January 10 applications, admission recommendation letters sent by March 15; offer acceptance due April 15 (recurring, undated).

applicationFee.note: International graduate application fee. No applicable graduate waiver verified; the site-wide freshman/transfer waiver banner is not a graduate policy.

english.note: Central regular-admission minima; PTE53 also accepted. Qualifying English-speaking-country or English-medium education alternatives are listed centrally.

documents: Official transcripts for bachelor’s and any master’s degrees
Proof of English proficiency for international applicants
requirements.note: Bachelor’s in biology, chemistry, biochemistry or related field; overall and major GPA 3.0; strong science/math preparation and research experience required. Contact faculty during fall before applying with CV/unofficial transcripts; admission depends on a faculty member committing to mentor from the start. Three recommendations through portal from academic/research referees. GRE/MCAT or similar scores optional.

funding.note: Typically funded through teaching/research assistantships with stipend and tuition waiver. Faculty sponsor develops a semester-by-semester funding plan during application. No universal funding or explicit international guarantee established.
